article.title: Angela Gonzales-Torres Hopes to Bring International Solidarity to the U.S. House
article.author: Democratic Left
article.content: DSA’s candidate for a Los Angeles congressional seat hopes to defeat a major recipient of AIPAC cash by making clear that U.S. imperialism comes at a cost to the well-being of Americans — and of people around the world. The post Angela Gonzales-Torres Hopes to Bring International Solidarity to the U.S. House appeared first on Democratic Left .
